mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_interaction_callback ( provider_code, interaction_no, idempotency_key, business_type, business_id, mobile_no, user_id, http_method, endpoint, request_id, request_hash, request_ref, response_code, response_msg, response_ref, success, duration_ms ) VALUES ( #{providerCode}, #{interactionNo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{mobileNo}, #{userId}, #{httpMethod}, #{endpoint}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, #{requestRef}, #{responseCode}, #{responseMsg}, #{responseRef}, #{success, typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.BooleanTinyintTypeHandler}, #{durationMs} )
mapper.update: UPDATE external_interaction_callback SET mobile_no = COALESCE(#{mobileNo}, mobile_no), user_id = COALESCE(#{userId}, user_id), response_code = #{responseCode}, response_msg = #{responseMsg}, response_ref = #{responseRef}, success = #{success, typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.BooleanTinyintTypeHandler}, duration_ms = #{durationMs} WHERE id = #{id}
